about.delivery_body: Delivery is free in Belgium, the Netherlands and the Vienne department (postcodes starting 86, around Poitiers). We agree a time slot with you, assemble the bike, hand it over in person and answer your questions on the spot.
about.delivery_elsewhere: Outside those areas, the order is collected from the shop in Poitiers, on the same price and warranty terms.
about.description: Vitesse Eco is an electric bike shop based in Poitiers, France. Free delivery by our own team in Belgium, the Netherlands and the Poitiers area, and collection in store everywhere else.
about.difference_body: On a marketplace the bike is shipped in a box by a seller nobody has ever met, and the warranty is handled through a form. Here, the company selling you the bike is the one that assembles it, the one that brings it to your door and the one you call six months later. It is the same people from the first question to the after-sales.
about.difference_body_2: That comes at an honest cost: we only deliver where our own van goes. Everywhere else we would rather offer collection in store than hand a bike weighing several dozen kilos to a courier.
about.difference_title: Why this is not a marketplace

cgv.data_p1: To process an order we need your name, email address, phone number and delivery address. That data is processed by VITESSE ECO as data controller, in order to perform the contract between us, and it is neither sold nor rented.
cgv.data_p2: Your payment data never reaches us: it is handled directly by Stripe. The detail of what is processed, how long it is kept and how to exercise your rights is set out in the privacy policy.
cgv.delivery_p1: We deliver with our own team and our own vehicles, with no carrier in between. Home delivery is free to Belgium, the Netherlands and to French addresses whose postcode begins with 86, that is the Vienne, around Poitiers.
cgv.delivery_p2: Everywhere else, the order is collected free of charge at our Poitiers address. The delivery method actually available for your address is shown to you before payment: we never offer an option we cannot honour.
cgv.delivery_p3: After the order is confirmed we contact you to agree a slot. Delivery, or availability for collection, normally happens within two to seven working days, and in any event within thirty days of the contract being concluded, as article L216-1 of the French Consumer Code requires.
cgv.delivery_p4: If we miss that date, you can require us to deliver within a reasonable further period, and then cancel the order if we still have not. Sums paid are refunded within fourteen days of the cancellation.
cgv.delivery_p5: We need a complete address, a phone number we can reach and your presence at the agreed slot. If nobody is there, we agree another visit.
cgv.delivery_p6: Check the product in front of our team when it is handed over, and report any damage or missing item there and then. Saying nothing costs you neither your right of withdrawal nor the legal guarantees, but noting it immediately makes putting things right far simpler.
cgv.description: VITESSE ECO terms and conditions of sale: ordering, prices, payment, delivery by our own team, the 14-day right of withdrawal and the legal guarantees.
cgv.guarantees_note: These texts are reproduced as in force on the date this page was last updated. The French version published on Légifrance is the authoritative one.
cgv.guarantees_p1: Independently of any commercial warranty, we owe the legal guarantee of conformity and the guarantee against hidden defects. They are free, they cannot be bought, and no clause in this document can cut them down.
cgv.guarantees_p2: The guarantee of conformity covers, for two years from delivery, any defect that makes the product other than what was described or unfit for what an electric bike is expected to do. You choose between repair and replacement, at no cost; if neither is possible within a reasonable time, you can obtain a price reduction or cancel the sale.
cgv.guarantees_p3: A defect appearing within twenty-four months is presumed to have existed since delivery: you do not have to prove where it came from, it is for us to show otherwise. A product brought back into conformity by repair is then guaranteed for a further six months.
cgv.guarantees_p4: The guarantee against hidden defects lets you, for two years from discovering the defect, return the product and be refunded, or keep it and have part of the price returned.
cgv.guarantees_p5: To rely on either, write to our contact address with your order number, a description of the problem and photos where possible. We then tell you whether we collect the product or you send it back; either way, putting it right costs you nothing.
cgv.intro: These terms govern every order placed on vitesse-eco.fr. They are written to be read: each article states what we owe, what you owe, and what happens when something goes wrong.
cgv.law_p1: These terms are governed by French law. If you live in another European Union country, that choice does not deprive you of any of the mandatory protections given to you by the law of your country of residence.
cgv.law_p2: If something goes wrong, write to us first: most disputes are settled in a single exchange. We acknowledge every written complaint and answer it in writing.
cgv.law_p3: If our answer does not satisfy you, you may, within one year of your written complaint, refer the matter free of charge to a consumer mediator. The contact details of the mediator VITESSE ECO is registered with are provided on request to our contact address.
cgv.law_p4: The European online dispute resolution platform was closed on 20 July 2025. The mediator named above is therefore the applicable amicable route.
cgv.law_p5: Mediation stays optional: you keep the right to go to the competent court at any time. Disputes with a business buyer fall to the courts having jurisdiction where VITESSE ECO has its registered office.
cgv.liability_p1: We are liable as of right for the proper performance of the order, including where part of it is entrusted to a third party. We are released only if the failure is attributable to you, to the unforeseeable and insurmountable act of a third party unconnected with the contract, or to force majeure.
cgv.liability_p2: An electrically assisted bike is still a vehicle. It is for you to follow the traffic rules of the country you ride in, to wear whatever equipment is compulsory there, and not to tamper with the assistance limiter: a derestricted bike stops being a bicycle in law, loses its warranty and is no longer covered by your insurance.
cgv.liability_p3: We are not liable for damage resulting from such use, or from using a battery or charger other than the one supplied with the bike.
cgv.liability_title: Liability and use of the product
cgv.order_p1: An order is built in four steps: you add items to the basket, you give the country, the postcode and your email address, you choose a delivery method from those actually available for that address, and then a payment method.
cgv.order_p2: The summary shown before payment lists the items, any discount, the delivery cost and the total payable. Until you confirm, you can go back and correct any of it.
cgv.order_p3: The sale is concluded when we confirm the order by email. For an online payment, that confirmation follows acceptance of the payment by our provider; a declined payment forms no contract.
cgv.order_p4: Products are offered while stocks last. If an item becomes unavailable after your order, we tell you and refund that item, or the whole order if you prefer, within fourteen days.
cgv.order_p5: We may refuse or cancel an order in the event of a manifest pricing error, an unresolved payment dispute on an earlier order, or an order that is abnormal for a retail business. You are told, and refunded in full.
cgv.order_p6: The records kept in our systems constitute proof of the order, its content and its date.
cgv.payment_p1: Online payment is handled by Stripe. Depending on your country it accepts payment cards (Visa, Mastercard, CB), iDEAL in the Netherlands and Bancontact in Belgium. Your card details are entered on Stripe's secure form and never pass through our servers, which keep no record of them.
cgv.payment_p2: The amount is taken when the order is placed. With a delayed-settlement method such as iDEAL or a bank transfer, the order is confirmed only once the funds have actually arrived; if the payment fails, the order is cancelled and the reserved items go back on sale.
cgv.payment_p3: In Belgium and the Netherlands you can pay cash on delivery: our team collects the exact amount when the product is handed over. This method is not offered for a collection in store.
cgv.payment_p4: For a collection in store, payment is made at the counter when you collect.
cgv.payment_p5: The goods remain our property until the price has been paid in full. This retention of title does not affect the transfer of risk, which happens on delivery and is dealt with in article 7.
cgv.prices_p1: All prices are shown in euros, VAT included at the applicable French rate. The price shown when you confirm the order is the price you are charged: nothing is added afterwards, no handling fee, no fuel surcharge, no payment surcharge.
cgv.prices_p2: The delivery cost, where there is one, appears separately in the summary before payment and is included in the total. A struck-through price next to the selling price is a price we genuinely charged before, not an estimate of value.
cgv.prices_p3: We may change our prices at any time. A rise or a fall never applies to an order already confirmed.
cgv.prices_p4: A manifestly wrong price, derisory for the product concerned, does not bind us. In that case we cancel the order, tell you without delay and refund you in full.
cgv.prices_p5: A confirmation email recapping your order is sent to you on a durable medium. An invoice is issued on request to our contact address.
cgv.quote_civil_1641: The seller is bound by a warranty against hidden defects in the thing sold which render it unfit for its intended use, or which so impair that use that the buyer would not have bought it, or would have paid a lower price, had they known of them.
cgv.quote_civil_1648: An action arising from redhibitory defects must be brought by the buyer within two years of discovering the defect.
cgv.quote_l217_3: The seller shall deliver goods that conform to the contract and to the criteria set out in article L. 217-5. The seller is liable for any lack of conformity existing at the time the goods are delivered within the meaning of article L. 216-1, which becomes apparent within two years of that delivery.
cgv.quote_l217_7: Any lack of conformity which becomes apparent within twenty-four months of delivery of the goods, including goods with digital elements, is presumed, unless proved otherwise, to have existed at the time of delivery, unless that presumption is incompatible with the nature of the goods or of the alleged lack of conformity.
cgv.quote_l217_9: Where goods do not conform, the consumer is entitled to have them brought into conformity by repair or replacement or, failing that, to a price reduction or to cancellation of the contract, under the conditions set out in this sub-section.
cgv.risk_p1: The risk of loss of or damage to the product passes to you when you take physical possession of it, that is on delivery or at handover in the shop, and not when you pay.
cgv.risk_p2: Before that moment, any damage in transit is ours to bear, since it is our own team doing the transporting.
cgv.scope_p1: These terms apply to every sale concluded at a distance on vitesse-eco.fr, whatever delivery or payment method is chosen. They apply to consumer and business buyers alike; the articles that concern consumers only say so.
cgv.scope_p2: We serve France, Belgium, the Netherlands, Luxembourg, Germany and Spain. An order placed for an address outside those countries cannot be fulfilled: it is cancelled and refunded in full.
cgv.scope_p3: Placing an order means accepting these terms in full. They are reachable at any time from the footer, and you can save or print them before paying.
cgv.scope_p4: The version that applies to your order is the one published on the day you place it. A later change never applies to an order already placed.
cgv.seller_p1: The vitesse-eco.fr online shop is operated by VITESSE ECO, a simplified joint-stock company registered in France, which sells electric bikes, spare parts, accessories and children's vehicles.
cgv.seller_p2: For any question about an order, these are the right contact details: they reach the team that prepares and delivers the orders, not a call centre.
cgv.title: Terms and conditions of sale
cgv.warranty_p1: Some products also carry a commercial warranty granted by their manufacturer. Its duration and scope are stated on the product page or in the documents supplied with the product. It comes on top of the legal guarantees and never replaces them: you can always choose to rely on the legal guarantee instead.
cgv.warranty_p2: The commercial warranty does not cover wear parts such as tyres, inner tubes, brake pads, chain and cables, nor damage caused by an accident, lack of maintenance, modification of the bike or use contrary to its manual. The legal guarantees remain owed in every case.
cgv.warranty_p3: We supply spare parts for the models we sell. Where the manufacturer states how long the parts essential to using the product will remain available, that period is shown on the product page.
cgv.withdrawal_p1: If you are a consumer, you have fourteen days to change your mind, with no reason to give and no penalty to pay. The period runs from the day you, or a third party you designated, physically receive the product.
cgv.withdrawal_p2: A purchase collected in store carries exactly the same right: the contract was concluded at a distance, on this site, and that is what counts.
cgv.withdrawal_p3: To exercise it, tell us clearly before the deadline, by email or using the model form. Then return the product within fourteen days of that statement. The direct cost of returning it is yours; in the areas we deliver ourselves we can come and collect it, and we tell you what that costs before we come.
cgv.withdrawal_p4: We refund every sum paid, including the standard delivery cost, within fourteen days of your statement and using the same payment method. We may hold that refund until the product is back with us or until you show it has been dispatched.
cgv.withdrawal_p5: You can try the product as you would in a shop. You are, however, liable for any loss of value caused by handling beyond that: a bike ridden on the road, scratched, or whose battery has been heavily cycled is no longer new, and the refund is reduced by that loss of value.
cgv.withdrawal_p6: The right of withdrawal does not apply to goods made or personalised to your specification, nor to unsealed items that cannot be returned for hygiene reasons.

faq.a_assembled: Where we deliver ourselves, the bike is assembled and checked before it is handed over, and we set the saddle and handlebars with you. For collection in store, it is ready to ride when you arrive.
faq.a_cash: Yes, in Belgium and the Netherlands, where our own team delivers. Cash is capped at 3,000 €, because a driver should not be carrying unlimited amounts. The order stays pending until we have been paid.
faq.a_charging: With the charger supplied, from an ordinary domestic socket; the battery can usually be removed and charged indoors. Capacity and charging time are stated on each model's page. A battery stored over winter should be kept away from frost and roughly half charged.
faq.a_cost: Nothing, everywhere we deliver ourselves: Belgium, the Netherlands and the Poitiers area. There is no surcharge at payment. Collection in store is free too.
faq.a_legal: An electric bike is treated as a bicycle as long as the assistance cuts out at 25 km/h and the motor's rated power does not exceed 250 W: no registration, no licence and no compulsory insurance. Beyond those limits the vehicle changes category and requires registration, insurance and an approved helmet. Wide tyres change nothing in that rule: check the speed and power stated on the model you choose, and ask us if anything is unclear.
faq.a_parts: Yes, for the models we carry. If the part you need is not in the catalogue, write to us with the model and a photo if you have one: we will tell you what we can get and how long it will take.
faq.a_payment_methods: Online payment goes through Stripe: bank card, and depending on your country iDEAL in the Netherlands or Bancontact in Belgium. In Belgium and the Netherlands you can also pay our driver in cash. In the shop, cash or card at the counter.
faq.a_payment_security: Your card number is entered at Stripe, our payment provider, and never passes through our servers. We neither see nor store any card data.
faq.a_pickup: Yes. Collection is at 32 Rue du Faubourg du Pont Neuf, 86000 Poitiers. Tell us before you come, so the bike is ready when you arrive.
faq.a_range: The range quoted on a product page is measured in favourable conditions. In practice it depends on your weight, the terrain, the assistance level, tyre pressure and the temperature: in real cold, a battery gives noticeably less. Trust the specification of the model you are looking at rather than an average.
faq.a_returns: You have fourteen days from delivery to tell us you are withdrawing, with no reason needed, then fourteen more days to send the product back. It must come back complete and in a condition that allows resale. We then refund everything you paid, including standard delivery. Return shipping is at your expense.
faq.a_time: We call or message you to agree a slot, because it is our own team coming: you get a date, not a carrier's window. If no date is agreed, French law sets a maximum of thirty days from the order.
faq.a_tracking: Every order has a number, repeated in the confirmation email. Your account shows its status; for anything not shown there, a message or a call is enough — we prepare and deliver the orders ourselves, so we know where yours is.
faq.a_warranty: The legal guarantee of conformity applies for two years from delivery, and the guarantee against hidden defects remains available beyond that on the terms set by law. Both are free and need no registration. Wearing parts — tyres, brake pads, cables — are not covered by them.
faq.a_where: Our own team delivers to the door in Belgium, the Netherlands and the Vienne department in France (postcodes starting 86, around Poitiers). We also sell to the rest of France, Germany and Spain: those orders are collected from our shop in Poitiers.

guide.description: Three questions about how you will ride, how far you go in a day and what you want to spend, and we show the fat-tyre electric bikes that answer them — with the reason for each.
guide.help_body: Tell us your postcode and how you will ride. We answer ourselves, with the real stock in front of us, and we will tell you plainly if none of our bikes is right for you.
guide.incomplete: Answer the three questions and we will put forward three models, each with its reason.
guide.lead: A fatbike comes down to three things: what you will do with it, how far you ride in a day, and what you are willing to spend. Answer, and we will show you the models that fit, with the reason for each one. Your answers stay in the page address, so you can share it or use the back button.
guide.method_note: The range a manufacturer claims is measured in favourable conditions: flat ground, mild weather, low assistance. Where a span is given we take the lower figure when deciding whether the bike covers your distance. Hills, cold and your own weight account for the rest.
guide.no_match_body: We would rather say so than quietly show you something else. Here are the closest models, with what does not line up stated on each one.

privacy.cookies_none_else: There is no advertising cookie, no social network button and no third-party analytics tool, Google Analytics or otherwise, on this site. Because the cookies above are strictly necessary to the service you asked for, they need no consent: that is why this site puts no banner in your way.
privacy.data_account_body: First name, last name, email address, phone number if you give one, and the language you use the site in. Your password is never kept in readable form: only a bcrypt hash is stored, and a hash cannot be turned back into the password. If you sign in with Google we keep the Google account identifier and your email, never your Google password.
privacy.data_addresses_body: First name, last name, phone, street, additional line, postcode, town and country of the delivery and billing addresses you save, plus the label you give them.
privacy.data_country_body: Our host's network tells us which country your visit comes from. It is used only to point out that a version of the site matches your market. It is not stored and never triggers a redirect: the choice stays yours.
privacy.data_intro: We collect nothing beyond the following, and we buy no data from third parties.
privacy.data_messages_body: The name, email address, subject and content of messages sent through the contact form, plus the language they were sent in.
privacy.data_orders_body: The items ordered with their price at the time, the amounts, the VAT applied, the delivery and payment methods, the delivery address as it stood that day, the tracking number and any note you add. These are frozen: an order is the record of what was bought and must not change when the catalogue is edited two years later.
privacy.data_security_body: A hash of your IP address, computed with a secret key and not reversible, is used to limit repeated attempts on forms. An internal log records sensitive operations such as an order changing status or an administrator acting on it.
privacy.data_session_body: A random token placed in a cookie. We store only its SHA-256 hash, together with your browser name and a hash of your IP address, so that you can recognise your active sessions.
privacy.description: What data Vitesse Eco collects, why, how long it is kept and how to exercise your rights.
privacy.intro: This page describes what this site actually does with your data. It is written from how the site works rather than from a template: every item below matches something we really store.
privacy.minors_body: Accounts and orders are for adults. The children's vehicles we sell are meant to be bought by an adult. We do not knowingly collect data about anyone under fifteen; if you find that an account was created by a minor, write to us and we will delete it.
privacy.no_marketing: We send no newsletter and no marketing message, and we build no commercial profile. If that ever changes, your consent would be asked for first (article 6.1.a) and could be withdrawn at any time without affecting your orders.
privacy.payment_body: Your card details never reach this site. Payment happens at Stripe: we send the amount, the currency, your email address, the item names and the order reference, and we receive back a transaction identifier and its status. We never see your card number, its expiry date or its security code, so we could not disclose them.
privacy.payment_cash: Cash on delivery, offered in Belgium and the Netherlands, involves no provider at all: only the fact that the order was settled is recorded.
privacy.purpose_abuse_basis: Legitimate interest (article 6.1.f): protecting our customers' accounts and the availability of the site.
privacy.purpose_abuse_retention: Rate-limit counters expire in under an hour. Internal log entries are kept for twelve months.
privacy.purpose_account_basis: Performance of a contract (article 6.1.b): the account is the service you ask us to provide.
privacy.purpose_account_retention: Until you delete your account. An account with no order and no sign-in for three years is deleted.
privacy.purpose_legal_basis: Legal obligation (article 6.1.c): accounting, VAT, the legal guarantee of conformity and the right of withdrawal.
privacy.purpose_legal_retention: Ten years for accounting records, two years after delivery for anything covered by the legal guarantee.
privacy.purpose_messages_basis: Legitimate interest (article 6.1.f): answering someone who writes to us. If your message concerns an order, the basis is performance of the contract.
privacy.purpose_messages_retention: Three years after the last exchange.
privacy.purpose_orders_retention: Ten years, the period for which French commercial law requires accounting records to be kept. Data not needed for accounting is anonymised before then.
privacy.purpose_orders_title: Processing, delivering and invoicing your orders
privacy.purpose_session_basis: Performance of a contract (article 6.1.b): an account cannot work without a session.
privacy.purpose_session_retention: Thirty days, extended while you keep using the site. The session is deleted at once when you sign out or change your password.
privacy.purposes_intro: Each use has a specific purpose, a legal basis under article 6 GDPR, and a period after which the data is deleted or anonymised.
privacy.purposes_title: Why, on what legal basis, and for how long
privacy.recipient_cloudflare: Cloudflare provides the anti-bot check on our forms.
privacy.recipient_neon: Neon hosts the PostgreSQL database in a European Union region. That is where your account, your addresses, your orders and your messages live.
privacy.recipient_sanity: Sanity manages the product catalogue. No account, no address and no order is copied into it: that system holds no personal data.
privacy.recipient_stripe: Stripe processes online payments and for that receives your email, the amount and the order reference.
privacy.recipient_vercel: Vercel hosts the site and runs the server code that answers your requests.
privacy.recipients_internal: Internally, access is limited to the people who prepare orders, deliver them and answer messages, and only to what they need in order to do so. Externally, the following providers act on our behalf and on our instructions.
privacy.recipients_no_sale: We do not sell, rent or trade personal data, to anyone, for any purpose.
privacy.recipients_title: Who has access to your data
privacy.right_access_body: Have it confirmed whether we process data about you, and receive a copy of it.
privacy.right_consent_body: Withdraw a consent at any time, without calling into question what was done before. None of the processing described here currently relies on your consent.
privacy.right_erasure_body: Ask for your data to be deleted where we no longer have a legitimate or legal reason to keep it.
privacy.right_objection_body: Object, on grounds relating to your situation, to processing based on our legitimate interest, in particular keeping your messages.
privacy.right_portability_body: Receive the data you gave us in a machine-readable format, and ask us to pass it to another controller.
privacy.right_postmortem_body: Set instructions on what happens to your data after your death, and name the person responsible for carrying them out.
privacy.right_rectification_body: Have inaccurate information corrected or incomplete information completed. Your name, email, phone and addresses can be changed directly from your account.
privacy.right_restriction_body: Ask for processing to be frozen while a dispute is examined.
privacy.rights_cnil: If our answer does not satisfy you, you may complain to the CNIL, the French supervisory authority, by post or online at
privacy.rights_how: To exercise a right, write to contact{'@'}vitesse-eco.fr from your account's email address, or by post to the registered office. Where there is reasonable doubt about your identity we may ask for proof. We answer within one month, extended to three if the request is complex, in which case we tell you before the first month is out.
privacy.rights_intro: The General Data Protection Regulation gives you the following rights over your information.
privacy.rights_limits: Some data cannot be erased on request: invoices and accounting records must be kept for ten years by law. Where that applies, access is restricted to what is strictly necessary and the data is no longer used for anything else.
privacy.security_admin: Access to the admin area is limited to a named list of email addresses, checked on every request.
privacy.security_cookies: The authentication cookie is httpOnly, Secure and SameSite=Lax, and any action that changes your data is refused when it comes from another site.
privacy.security_ip: IP addresses are never kept in the clear: only a hash computed with a secret key is stored.
privacy.security_passwords: Passwords are hashed with bcrypt at twelve rounds. Neither we nor anyone holding a copy of the database can read them.
privacy.security_sessions: The session token is never stored, only its hash. A copy of the database therefore cannot be replayed as a sign-in.
privacy.security_transport: All traffic runs over HTTPS, and the pages enforce a restrictive content security policy.
privacy.storage_cart: What is in your basket, so it survives closing the tab. It is sent to us only to work out the total shown and when you order, and is stored on our side only if you do order.
privacy.storage_intro: Two things are kept in your browser rather than on our side. You can clear them at any time by deleting the site data.
privacy.storage_market: The fact that you dismissed the banner suggesting another version of the site, so it is not offered twice.
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.transfers_body: The database holding your information is hosted in the European Union. Vercel, Stripe and Cloudflare, however, belong to groups established in the United States, and some processing may take place there. Those transfers are covered by the standard contractual clauses adopted by the European Commission and, for the companies that have joined it, by the EU-US Data Privacy Framework.

withdrawal.condition_body: You may handle and try the goods as you would in a shop, that is, as much as is needed to establish their nature, characteristics and working order. You are liable only for any diminished value resulting from handling that goes beyond that.
withdrawal.condition_deduction: Any deduction is proportionate to the loss of value. We tell you the amount and how we worked it out, in writing, before applying it.
withdrawal.condition_not_ok_1: Kilometres on the road: worn tyres and brake pads, a dirty drivetrain.
withdrawal.condition_not_ok_2: Scratches, dents, chipped paint, missing parts or accessories.
withdrawal.condition_not_ok_3: A bike sent back without protection and damaged in transit.
withdrawal.condition_ok_1: Unpacking the bike, assembling it, examining it, switching on the display and the lights.
withdrawal.condition_ok_2: A short test on private ground to check the motor assistance and the brakes.
withdrawal.condition_ok_3: Charging the battery once to confirm that it works.
withdrawal.condition_title: The condition the goods come back in
withdrawal.costs_body: The direct cost of returning the goods is yours to bear. For an electric bike that is not a token sum: the parcel is bulky and heavy, and the battery falls under a special transport regime.
withdrawal.costs_dropoff_free: A return dropped off in Poitiers costs you nothing.
withdrawal.costs_estimate: Ask us for an estimate before you send anything. We will tell you the carrier's price for your address, and you decide from there.
withdrawal.costs_outbound: We refund the outward delivery cost you paid. Since our delivery is free to Belgium, the Netherlands and French postcode 86, there is usually nothing to refund there. If you chose a faster or more expensive delivery than our standard offer, the difference stays with you.
withdrawal.exceptions_body: Directive 2011/83 and article L221-28 of the French Consumer Code list the exceptions exhaustively. The ones that can apply to us:
withdrawal.exceptions_custom: Goods made to your specification or clearly personalised: a bike built to measure or painted to your request.
withdrawal.exceptions_mixed: Goods which, after delivery, have been inseparably mixed with other items.
withdrawal.exceptions_note: Outside these cases the right applies in full. We do not set it aside for any other reason, and certainly not because a box has been opened.
withdrawal.exceptions_sealed: Sealed goods which cannot be returned for reasons of hygiene or health protection, and which you unsealed after delivery.
withdrawal.exceptions_service: A workshop service fully performed before the period ends, with your prior express consent and your express acknowledgement that you lose the right.
withdrawal.exceptions_title: Where the law sets the right aside
withdrawal.form_copy_failed: Copying did not work. Select the text below.
withdrawal.form_intro: Fill in and return this form only if you wish to withdraw. It is not compulsory: a clear statement by email or by post has exactly the same effect.
withdrawal.form_signature_note: only if this form is notified on paper
withdrawal.form_statement: I hereby give notice that I withdraw from my contract of sale of the following goods:
withdrawal.glance_decide_body: The period starts the day after you receive the goods.
withdrawal.glance_refund_body: Once we have the goods back or your proof of dispatch, to the original means of payment.
withdrawal.glance_return_body: Counted from the day you tell us of your decision.
withdrawal.guarantee_body: Withdrawal lets you walk away from a purchase that is perfectly fine. It has nothing to do with the two-year legal guarantee of conformity or the guarantee against hidden defects, which cover faulty goods and remain open long after the fourteen days. A bike that breaks down is a guarantee matter, not a matter for this page.
withdrawal.guarantee_link: Read the terms and conditions of sale
withdrawal.guarantee_title: Withdrawal and guarantees are two different things
withdrawal.help_body: Write to us or call. We will tell you the carrier, the return cost for your address and what to do about the battery.
withdrawal.help_title: A question before you send it back
withdrawal.how_ack: We acknowledge your withdrawal by email, without delay.
withdrawal.how_body: Before the period runs out, send us an unambiguous statement. The form below does the job, but any clear message works just as well.
withdrawal.how_proof: It is the date you send your statement that counts, not the date we reply. Keep proof that you sent it.
withdrawal.intro: You ordered at a distance, so you may change your mind within 14 days, without giving a reason and without penalty. This page explains how to tell us, what the return costs, and gives you the form to send back.
withdrawal.meta_description: You have 14 days to change your mind about a distance order from Vitesse Eco: conditions, return costs, refunds and a printable model withdrawal form.
withdrawal.period_body: The period is fourteen calendar days. It begins the day after you take physical possession of the goods, whether that is you or a third party you designated, other than the carrier.
withdrawal.period_multiple: If your order contains several goods delivered separately, the period runs from the day after the last item arrives.
withdrawal.period_weekend: If the last day falls on a Saturday, a Sunday or a public holiday, it moves to the next working day.
withdrawal.refund_body: We refund every sum you paid, including the standard delivery cost, no later than fourteen days after the day we are informed of your decision.
withdrawal.refund_cash: An order paid in cash on delivery cannot be refunded the same way, so we pay by bank transfer, to the IBAN you give us and with your agreement.
withdrawal.refund_hold: We may hold the refund until we have the goods back, or until you supply proof that you dispatched them, whichever happens first.
withdrawal.refund_method: The refund is made using the same means of payment as the order, at no cost to you.
withdrawal.return_battery: The lithium battery is regulated dangerous goods in transport (UN 3481). Many carriers refuse it, or require specific packaging and labelling, so contact us before you ship anything and we will arrange the return with you.
withdrawal.return_body: You then have a further fourteen days, from the day you inform us, to send the goods back or hand them over. Dispatching within that period is enough; the parcel may arrive later.
withdrawal.return_dropoff: You may also bring the goods back to us in Poitiers, by appointment. For a bike this is the simplest and cheapest route.
withdrawal.return_packaging: Keep the original packaging while the period is running. A bike sent back without its box and protection arrives damaged, and that damage would reduce the refund.
withdrawal.scope_body: The right of withdrawal belongs to a consumer buying at a distance: on vitesse-eco.fr, by telephone, by email or over WhatsApp. It applies in the same way in France, Belgium, the Netherlands, Germany and Spain, because it comes from EU Directive 2011/83.
withdrawal.scope_in_store: A purchase concluded in person at our Poitiers premises is not a distance purchase, and the law attaches no right of withdrawal to it. The legal guarantees apply either way.
withdrawal.scope_pro: A business purchase does not open this right, unless the buyer employs no more than five people and the purchase falls outside their main line of business.
withdrawal.title: Right of withdrawal
